title: Pulse Transform Utility Not Windows
description:
Aggregator introduction is adhoc and incomplete with the new element-id introduction system (introduce/show ids, no cutouts).

Reported:
- Step 4 (viewport) should elevate/show ALL windows (Top + Perspective), not only the first match of the window-kind id.
- Step 6 (add object) does not show the catalogue panel and tree item; drag-and-drop is impossible.

Root causes to fix at the framework/ui level:
1. useIntroductionElevation uses querySelector (first match only) — kind-id aliases on multiple window instances never all elevate.
2. useFirstDraggableElementAlias exists but is never wired into Panel/MobilePanel, so framework.panelTab.*.firstDraggable never mounts.

Make the element-id introduce/show path work end-to-end for the Aggregator brand tour (and the shared Puzzle 3D introduction).
summary:
Step 7 now pulses only the Transform utility, not the window silhouettes.

**Cause:** Any `[data-introduced]` descendant (including `#transform`) promoted the dock-stack SVG to `introduced`, and CSS suppressed every introduced stamp inside the stack so the utility itself could not pulse.

**Fix:** `isWindowChromeIntroducedTarget` limits silhouette promotion to window body stamps (`data-slot=window` / bare `framework.window.{segment}`). Nested utilities keep the inset pulse; CSS suppress is scoped to window-chrome stamps only.

**Verified:** utility-vs-silhouette + window-introduce + resolveWindowSilhouetteBorderKind tests (4 passed).
